h: Aharon and the Humility That Kindles Torah in Others

p: the connection of the holy Zohar's opening
that it opened with the virtues of the Torah,
the power of kindling the lamps
that was given to Aharon HaKohen,
as we have already spoken about this
(and it was explained in Parshas Beha'alosecha),
(מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה בְּהַעֲלוֹתְךָ, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה טו, ו)
perhaps it is because of me, etc.
the matter of the Menorah was not
merely the service of kindling alone;
than the offering of all the korbanos,
he was the one who offered them.
And the oil of the Menorah
of the kindling of the Menorah
is as written in Midrash Rabbah,
the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
that Yisrael were given the power
so to speak, to Hashem Yisbarach,
like the matter of "My sons have defeated Me"
"For the lips of the kohen guard knowledge,
and Torah they shall seek from his mouth,
כִּי מַלְאַךְ ה׳ צְבָאוֹת הוּא וְגוֹמֵר
for he is a messenger of Hashem Tzevakos, etc.";
that he is in the aspect of an angel,
who has no yetzer hara at all;
to illuminate in the heart of Yisrael
the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
נֵר ה׳ נִשְׁמַת אָדָם (מִשְׁלֵי כ, כז)
"the lamp of Hashem is the soul of man" (Mishlei 20:27),
and the light hidden in it.
And this is what the Midrash says,
and the Ramban, of blessed memory, asked
after all, at the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash,
the lamps too will be nullified.
which Aharon merited for his descendants,
that everyone who is of his seed
"Torah they shall seek from his mouth,"
and this is the meaning of
And of this Korach was jealous,
"For the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
and Hashem is in their midst."
since it was written in the Torah,
the Torah would not have written
that "the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
and Hashem is in their midst."
And this is according to what they said
(שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה פָּרָשַׁת יִשָּׁקֵנִי, א, ב)
Torah learning was implanted in their heart,
and with the utterance "You shall not have"
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their heart.
And this is what it says (Shemos 19:6):
all of them dedicated to Torah,
and "the lips of the kohen guard knowledge, etc.";
that is, that there was uprooted
the yetzer hara from their heart,
and they were all like angels,
"for he is a messenger of Hashem Tzevakos."
"for the entire congregation, all of them are holy":
that the yetzer hara was uprooted from their heart;
which are the Name of Hakadosh Baruch Hu,
with the crown-tip of the Yud,
and there is no need for Aharon,
words of Torah into their heart.
that although he was like an angel,
in whom there is no yetzer hara,
rather he looked to Hashem Yisbarach,
and not at all from his own power;
And to this Moshe answered him
"In the morning Hashem will make known, etc.,
He will draw near to Him,
and the one whom He will choose
He will draw near to Him";
and it is a doubled expression,
and the Ramban, of blessed memory,
"whom He will choose" — for the generations;
about which he was jealous of Aharon:
to illuminate in the hearts of Yisrael
the light of Torah she'b'al peh;
that he merited the Crown of Kehunah
that everyone who is of his seed
is holy with the holiness of Kehunah,
even if he is not worthy,
And to this he answered him:
"In the morning Hashem will make known, etc.,
and the holy one He will draw near to Him":
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
"and the one whom He will choose,"
that he merit the Crown of Kehunah

p: with the pasuk "More desirable than gold, etc.,"
about the preciousness of the Torah:
And this is according to what they said
"'And for one who covers the ancient' (Yeshayahu 23:18):
this is one who covers the things
that the Ancient of Days covered;
this is one who reveals the things
that the Ancient of Days covered;
for there are words of Torah
that is, the secrets of the Torah,
that the Ancient of Days covered."
And to sense the tastes of Torah
this power was given to Aharon,
that he illuminate the heart of Yisrael,
"For the lips of the kohen guard knowledge,
and Torah they shall seek from his mouth,
for he is a messenger of Hashem Tzevakos";
for he was like an angel.
"The face of Moshe was like the face of the sun";
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּצֵא, סח, י)
that he was like Adam HaRishon
who did not know evil at all,
and of whom it is written (Bereishis 2:25):
what the lightest of the light
And this is what they said in the Gemara
resembled the beauty of Adam HaRishon";
that is, the face of the sun,
And this is the beauty of Adam HaRishon
which outshone the orb of the sun.
the house was filled with light.
did not know of this at all,
and did not consider it his own merit,
but only that Hashem Yisbarach chose him,
that the red marking singled out.
likewise did not know at all,
and did not at all consider himself
but only that Hashem Yisbarach chose him.
And this is what they said (Chullin 89a):
"Greater is what is said of Moshe and Aharon
than what is said of Avraham, etc."
to bring down the words of Torah;
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג כ, א)
to illuminate the words of Torah
to sense the tastes of Torah.
And this is what it says:
And this is what is said:
"For he is a messenger of Hashem Tzevakos."
is the opposite of peace, etc.;
and what is it? Shabbos, etc."
as in the World to Come,
and one merits "to make the Shabbos"
"fortunate is he who makes for them
in the two chambers of the heart,
and there is cleared out from there
"for the entire congregation, all of them are holy,"
for the yetzer hara was cleared out,
And therefore there were written in the Torah
that all Yisrael are fit for this
and he was jealous of Aharon,
And this is the order of the holy Zohar.

paragraphs.text: Source: Chagigah 13a — “… לן) [ליגמרן] מר מעשה מרכבה. אמר להו: אגמרון לי מעשה בראשית. בתר דאגמרוה, אמרו ליה: ליגמרון מר במעשה מרכבה! אמר להו: תנינא בהו ״דבש וחלב תחת לשונך״, דברים המתוקין מדבש …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 206) — “The Gemara relates: Rav Yosef would study the Design of the Divine Chariot and was familiar with the subject, whereas the Elders of Pumbedita would study the act of Creation. paragraphs.text: Source: Shir HaShirim 4:11 — “נפת תטפנה שפתותיך כלה דבש וחלב תחת לשונך וריח שלמתיך כריח לבנון” — “Sweetness drops From your lips, O bride; Honey and milk Are under your tongue; And the scent of your robes Is like the scent of Lebanon.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 6:26 — “הוא אהרן ומשה אשר אמר יהוה להם הוציאו את בני ישראל מארץ מצרים על צבאתם” — “It is the same Aaron and Moses to whom יהוה said, “Bring forth the Israelites from the land of Egypt, troop by troop.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Bava Basra 75a — “כיוצא בדבר אתה אומר: ״ונתתה מהודך עליו״ – ולא כל הודך; זקנים שבאותו הדור אמרו: פני משה כפני חמה, פני יהושע כפני לבנה; אוי לה לאותה בושה, אוי לה לאותה כלימה.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 159) — “In a similar manner, you can say that God said to Moses about Joshua: “And you shall put of your honor upon him” (Numbers 27:20), which indicates that you should put some of your honor, but not all of your honor. The elders of that generation said: The face of Moses was as bright as the face of the sun; the face of Joshua was like the face of the moon. Woe for this embarrassment, woe for this disgrace, that we did …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Bereishis 37:9 — “ויחלם עוד חלום אחר ויספר אתו לאחיו ויאמר הנה חלמתי חלום עוד והנה השמש והירח ואחד עשר כוכבים משתחוים לי” — “He dreamed another dream and told it to his brothers, saying, “Look, I have had another dream: And this time, the sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Bereishis 28:11 — “ויפגע במקום וילן שם כי בא השמש ויקח מאבני המקום וישם מראשתיו וישכב במקום ההוא” — “He came upon a certain place and stopped there for the night, for the sun had set. Taking one of the stones of that place, he put it under his head and lay down in that place.”
